entities.summary: Eleonora Anna Maria Felice de Fonseca Pimentel was an Italian poet, librarian, and revolutionary. As a revolutionary, she was connected with the Neapolitan revolution and subsequent short-lived Neapolitan Republic of 1799, a sister republic of the French Republic and one of many set up in the 1790s in Europe.
